en: The Discourse on Truths. The setting was Śrāvastī.
Monks, whoever among you goes forth from the home to the homeless life out of right faith, all do so for the sake of knowing the four noble truths.

Which four? For the sake of the knowledge of the noble truth of suffering, the noble truth of the origin of suffering, the noble truth of the cessation of suffering, and the noble truth of the path leading to the cessation of suffering— therefore,

for the realization of these four noble truths that have not yet been realized, one should cultivate an exceedingly intense desire, exertion, perseverance, indefatigability, mindfulness, and clear comprehension.
And one should apply oneself to yoga.
With the noble truth of suffering, the noble truth of the origin of suffering, and the noble truth of the path leading to the cessation of suffering.
Wal_8 … o … ai … r … The *Satyasūtra* is completed. Wal_9 May there be protection! … svāhā!
